# Garden Plan

This is a garden plan for your garden. It includes a variety of plants and tips for maintaining the garden.

## Plants

* Tomatoes
* Cucumbers
* Carrots
* Lettuce

## Tips

* Water plants regularly
* Mulch around plants to retain moisture
* Prune plants to promote growth

This garden plan should help you keep your garden healthy and thriving.
